descriptions.notStarted: You have a very smart pet with you. Please take it to Bartos the pet instructor. With his guidance, the pet may do something different.
descriptions.inProgress: In order to request Bartos for help in teaching the evolving pet new movements, I'll need to bring him his favorite drink.
descriptions.completed: I gave Bartos the drink and taught the evolving pet. I can now order the pet to come right next to me. Type /petcome to have your pet come to you.
